review_notes: Twelve logical names from16function rows plus supported_languages same-name physical table alias. No views/COPY/authenticated/write objects. All twelve retained in denominator. Eight English-focused narrative surfaces demonstrated; detect_lang, detect_lang_conf, lemmatize and noun_chunks remain uncovered. The24-language registry maps default models, not installed-model inventory. Only release-declared en_core_web_sm3.8.0 and VADER run. Optional fastText downloads disabled and language pinned; no language-ID inference claimed. Current source adds composed SQL examples and related agent/example metadata only. Complete package diff retained/reviewed; compute methods, registrations, schemas, pipeline behavior, entrypoint and root dependencies unchanged. Actual released interface supports current-compatible mapping, not an exact-current execution claim. Table-in-out DESCRIBE exports bind INTEGER id passthrough plus actual emitted fields. Actual passthrough type depends on input schema; id omitted when not requested. Full argument exports retain defaults and input-table metadata.
